_note: Seed data for `npm run demo:nwc` and `npm run e2e:nwc-app` (two NWC test wallets: one traveller, one guide, so one guide here). Balances come from the wallets, not from this file. Prices are small (at most 1 000 sats for all tours together). The tours start about 30 minutes after the server starts: inside the 50 min lock window, with 3 blocks to spare for the hold-limit check. Every person and business here is fictional.
